local util = require("lib.util")
local M = {}
local ok, opt = pcall(require, "lib.optional")
if ok then opt.load() end

-- deadcode: root exported to the host
function M.run(x)
  util.greet(x)
  local r = helper()
  return r
end

local function helper() return 1 end

function M:method()
  self:other()
end

function M:other() end

function unused_global() end

local function dead_local() end

local cb = function() end
local function on_event() end
register("evt", on_event)
register("load", util.on_load)
register("save", { save = util.on_save })
M.hook = util.on_alias

return M
